Hi Tim / Jasmine —

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the draft MSA and flagged a handful of priority items we'll typically surface in a first-pass redline. Attaching our standard order form template and a short checklist. Please see key bullets below — these will speed up the review if you can confirm them now: 

- Data usage: confirm whether Keyframe will send customer PII to Redwood or only hashed/aggregated telemetry. If PII is in scope, we will include standard security exhibits and KMS/HSM notes.
- IP: our standard position is service + output license; if you need assignment/licensing back, flag that as high priority.
- Retention & Logging: provide required retention period for logs and whether audit-log export is needed for SOC2 audit purposes.
- Term & Termination: confirm if you need custom termination-for-convenience notice beyond our default 30 days.
- Liability cap: if countersuggesting a higher cap, provide rationale and any procurement playbook constraints.

Redline conventions (what we prefer):
- Submit a single tracked-change doc per artifact (MSA and Order Form).
- Add inline comment bubbles for commercial asks (pricing, SLAs).
- Attach a separate Exhibit A usage CSV / workbook instead of embedding tables in the doc where possible.

Attachments: orderform-template.xlsx | ExhibitA-usage-request.xlsx | redline-checklist.pdf

Once we have the intake sheet (Jasmine), I'll produce a first-pass redline within the 10-business-day window.

Thanks,
